verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own marketing documents in-product AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, which amounts to AI-driven triage of the user's own data. The evidence is only thin marketing snippets, though: none describes AI-generated insights, explanations or suggestions shown to users in the interface, and the risk score is a user-configured equation rather than AI output. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or recommendations surfaced in the UI, detail on what the agents output to analysts (summaries, rationale, suggested decisions), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
